title: Italian Center Attack: c3-d4 and the isolani you asked for

difficulty.label: Italian player who wants the centre, not the eighty-move Pianissimo

objective.summary: You chose the Italian and Black answered with its most common reply. Play the direct program — c3 then d4 — through the forcing sequence it starts: recapture correctly, meet the check with the sober Bd2, and arrive in the isolani tabiya knowing you chose it on purpose: the d4 pawn buys open lines, piece activity, and a plan.

planClasses.label: Build c3/d4 and recapture toward the centre
planClasses.description: Position-specific counting: c3 exists so that ...exd4 is met by cxd4, keeping two pawns abreast. The program's cost is the b1 knight's best square — the same debt every c3 system pays — which is why the check on b4 comes and why Bd2 answers it.

planClasses.label: Play the isolani game you purchased
planClasses.description: After ...d5 exd5 Nxd5 the structure is signed: White's d4 stands alone, and in exchange every White piece gets a file or a diagonal. The reusable isolani doctrine lives in the shape entry; this pack's job is to reach the tabiya with the pieces placed to use it.

planClasses.label: Gambit instead: 7.Nc3 (the Greco)
planClasses.description: Position-specific: block the check with the knight, offer e4, and play for open files and development while Black grabs. Catalogued, critical, and a memory battle — the classified door at the pack's decision point, not its spine.

annotations: The program's first move: d4 is coming, and ...exd4 will be answered by cxd4. The alternative repertoire — d3 and the long Pianissimo manoeuvring game — is classified below as a deviation, not an error.
Black counterattacks e4 rather than defending e5 — the main line. Slower defences like ...Qe7 or ...d6 hold the centre instead and are catalogued rows in the mirrored Black pack.
The point of c3, played before Black can organize against it. From here to the tabiya the moves are nearly forced on both sides — this is the sequence to know cold.
Recapture toward the centre: two pawns abreast, and the c5 bishop must move again or pin.

The check is the critical test of the whole program, and YOUR decision: the sober Bd2 (the spine — trade into the isolani game) or the Greco Gambit Nc3 (offer e4 for open lines). Both are authored thoughts; the drill is choosing one on purpose.
Block, offer the trade, and keep the structure: after the coming exchanges White's development lead is small but real, and the centre pawns tell both sides the plan.
Recapture with the knight the c3 program had orphaned: from d2 it re-routes via b3 or f1 into the isolani game. The queen recapture is legal and slower — the knight needed the square more.
Black frees the position at the classical moment — one move before d5 would have been a real threat by you. Meet it with the recapture that signs the structure.

The tabiya, with the census on the table: White's d4 pawn has no c- or e-file neighbour — the isolani, machine-derived from this position — and both e-files are empty of pawns. You bought activity with structure; the shape entry names the plans, and the middlegame starts now.

The Evans Gambit — the c3-d4 program bought with a wing pawn, one move earlier. A catalogued row and a storied repertoire of its own; it is here so that choosing the quiet start is a decision, not a default.

checkpoints.label: 6...Bb4+ — sober Bd2 or the Greco gambit: choose
9...Nxd5 — the isolani tabiya; count what you bought
You are past the authored line

deviations.note: 5.d3 is the Giuoco Pianissimo — the other Italian repertoire, catalogued in its own rows: keep the tension for thirty moves and outplay slowly. A temperament choice, not an evaluation claim; this pack exists for players who want the direct program instead.

7.Nc3 — the Greco Gambit (catalogued through 7...Nxe4 8.O-O in the Main Line row) — offers e4 for open lines while the b4 bishop and e4 knight dangle. Critical, theory-heavy, and unforgiving of half-memory: playing it unbooked is worse than not playing it. The classified door for the third plan class.

9.e5 declines the isolani and pushes past instead: the walked line 9...dxc4 10.exf6 Qxf6 trades the structural game for an unbalanced race where both sides have grabbed. Evaluated 2026-08-15 (Stockfish 18, depth 22): the resulting position is -1.12 for White, and 9.e5 is 1.09 worse than the spine's 9.exd5 at the decision itself. Play both ninth moves and compare the games, not the numbers.

feedbackClaims.text: At the 1400/1600/1800 rating bands (Lichess blitz+rapid, 2024-01 through 2026-07), the Italian position after 3.Bc4 was reached 44,467,486 times — the largest tabiya-depth family measured in this repo's wave-4a priority pull — with White scoring 50.1%, and 3...Bc5 (34.2%) is the most common reply this pack drills against.

In the final tabiya White's d4 pawn has no pawn on the c- or e-file of either colour beside it and no White pawn ahead of it — the isolated queen's pawn as a checkable board fact, derived from the machine-walked position rather than asserted.

graduationBlockers.statement: The iqp-white shape reference rests on hand-derived pawn arithmetic; running the shipped named_structure evaluator against the walked tabiya FEN would upgrade or refute it and has not been done.

The family was selected over B01 Scandinavian (56.3M games at two plies vs the Italian's 44.5M at five): the depth-incommensurability judgment is recorded in the wave log, and the Scandinavian remains the obvious next family on raw totals.

ENGINE-CHECKED 2026-08-15 and REFUTED at three points inside the sequence, which is three more than the blocker's own stated bar of one. 5.d4 is 0.14 below 5.d3, 6.cxd4 is 0.28 below 6.e5, and 7...Bxd2+ is 0.13 below 7...Nxe4. The differences are small, but 'the position's only good answer' is not a small claim. The feedbackClaim forcing-literacy was DELETED rather than rewritten: a replacement would be a new authored judgment this pass cannot ground. Separately, the p11-cxd4 annotation asserted that only the c-pawn can recapture on d4; Qxd4, cxd4 and Nxd4 are all legal, and the false clause was deleted.
Whether Bd2 or Nc3 is more common or scores better at these bands is unquantified below the family root.

ENGINE EVIDENCE NOW RECORDED — the root and authored positions have fixed-depth, manifest-linked Stockfish measurements. This makes the stated root assessment falsifiable at the named engine version and cost; it does not ground strategic prose, plan classes, annotations, or deviation classifications, and it is not a proof.
